metadata.summary: The customer ordered a Nova Lox Sandwich on a lightly toasted Onion bagel with Coleslaw and declined to add any extra lox or other items to their order.

messages.text: Hello there, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel, I'm BagelBot an AI Assistant, and How can I assist you today?
Yeah. Can I get a, everything bagel, with schmear, jalapeno cheddar bagel, plain, and, Novolog sandwich?

I don't see a Jalapeno Cheddar Bagel on our menu. We have an Everything Bagel, though. For the Nova Lox Sandwich, you'll need to pick just one bagel. We have Plain, Everything, Blueberry, Chocolate Chip, Cinnamon Raisin, Egg, Egg Everything, English Muffin, Garlic, French Toast BAGEL, Multigrain Bagel, Onion, Poppy, Pumpernickel,
For the Nova Lox Sandwich, you can choose the Onion bagel. Now, you'll need to pick just one lunch side. We have Chips, Cole Slaw, or Lays Chips for a dollar extra. Which would you prefer?
For the Nova Lox Sandwich with Onion bagel and Coleslaw, would you like it toasted, lightly toasted, toasted dark, or no toasting?
The Nova Lox Sandwich on a lightly toasted Onion bagel with Coleslaw sounds great. Now, would you like to add any extra lox to your sandwich? We have the option to add extra lox for five ninety-nine.
I'll put that together for you. Is there anything else I can get for you today?

Perfect, let me get that all put together for you. I'll need to confirm your order. You've got a Nova Lox Sandwich on a lightly toasted Onion bagel with Coleslaw. I'll go ahead and finalize that for you. We'll have it ready for pickup. If you need any further assistance, feel free to ask. Have a great day.
You're welcome. It was my pleasure to assist you. Have a great day and enjoy your Nova Lox Sandwich.
It's interesting. Didn't take my name. Didn't take my phone number. I'm guessing this is just because it's the test environment not actually pumping through.
